prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat -n src/trailhead/elevation.py && echo ---- && cat -n src/trailhead/pace.py && echo ---- && cat -n src/trailhead/report.py

cat -n src/trailhead/track.py && echo ---- && ls src/trailhead tests && grep -rn "ele" src/trailhead --include=*.py | grep -v "^src/trailhead/elevation.py\|track.py" | head -40 && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -3
grep -rn -i "none\|missing\|lost\|,,\|ele.*empty\|blank" tests README* docs 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ----; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
sed -n 1,25p tests/test_elevation.py && grep -n "^def " tests/test_elevation.py && cat tests/conftest.py | head -30

python - <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("tests/test_elevation.py")
p.write_text(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace(
    "from trailhead.elevation import gain_and_loss, highest_and_lowest, steepest_grade\n",
    "from trailhead.elevation import (\n    filled_elevations,\n    gain_and_loss,\n    highest_and_lowest,\n    steepest_grade,\n)\nfrom trailhead.track import Point, Track, TrackError\n", 1), encoding="utf-8")
p.write_text(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + '''

def test_missing_elevation_takes_the_nearest_earlier_one():
    track = Track("t", [Point(0, 0, None), Point(0, 0, 100), Point(0, 0, None), Point(0, 0, 130)])
    assert filled_elevations(track) == [100, 100, 100, 130]


def test_leading_gap_takes_the_nearest_later_one():
    track = Track("t", [Point(0, 0, None), Point(0, 0, None), Point(0, 0, 90)])
    assert filled_elevations(track) == [90, 90, 90]


def test_track_without_any_elevation_is_an_error():
    track = Track("t", [Point(0, 0, None), Point(0, 0, None)])
    with pytest.raises(TrackError):
        filled_elevations(track)
''', encoding="utf-8")
EOF
mypy src/ 2>&1 | tail -3; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; ruff check src tests 2>&1 | tail -3; ruff format --check src tests 2>&1 | tail -3
ruff format --diff tests/test_elevation.py 2>&1 | head -30; git stash -q && ruff format --check src tests 2>&1 | tail -1; git stash pop -q && git status --short | grep -v '^??'
